name: QKZ Ak6
description: Key specifications and variants include: Audio Specs: 10mm dynamic driver, 16–32 Ω impedance, 108 dB sensitivity, and a frequency response of 15 Hz – 29 kHz.  Connectivity: Primarily 3.5mm wired with an inline microphone; some variants offer detachable cables (MMCX) or Bluetooth connectivity.  Build & Comfort: Plastic or metal enclosures, lightweight (~8g), with tangle-free TPE cables and included carrying cases.  Comparison: Compared to alternatives like the KZ AK3 or Moondrop CHU, the AK6 provides deeper bass but lower isolation and non-detachable cables in its standard form.
